mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, username, action, entity, entity_id, before_json, after_json, ip, user_agent, trace_id, at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{action}, #{entity}, #{entityId}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{traceId}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM audit_log LIMIT 100000) t
